extractions.description: Empirical compute study using graph-based music recommenders, pretrained feature extractors, two public music datasets, and several popularity-bias mitigation and evaluation procedures.

type.quote: Through a series of empirical results, we show that our fairness framework enables us to outperform a series of accepted fairness benchmarks
type.justification: The paper trains and evaluates methods experimentally on two datasets.
